name: home_away
description: Whether this team was the home or away team for this game.
logic: NA

name: rest_days
description: Days of rest this team had entering this game (0 = a back-to-back). NA for a team's first game of the season.
logic: Days since this team's previous game in the same season, minus 1.

name: opp_rest_days
description: The opponent's rest_days for this same game.
logic: NA

name: is_b2b
description: TRUE if this team is playing on zero days of rest (a back-to-back).
logic: rest_days == 0

name: opp_is_b2b
description: The opponent's is_b2b for this same game.
logic: NA

name: is_3in4
description: TRUE if this game is the second of two games within 2 days with <=1 rest day between them (a proxy for 3-games-in-4-nights fatigue).
logic: rest_days <= 1 AND the previous game's rest_days was also <= 1.

name: opp_is_3in4
description: The opponent's is_3in4 for this same game.
logic: NA

name: est_flight_time
description: Estimated flight time (hours) from this team's previous game city to this game's city.
logic: Looked up from the travel-time reference table by previous-city -> current-city.

name: opp_est_flight_time
description: The opponent's est_flight_time for this same game.
logic: NA

name: time_zone_shift
description: Number of timezones crossed from this team's previous game city to this game's city.
logic: Looked up from the travel-time reference table.

name: opp_time_zone_shift
description: The opponent's time_zone_shift for this same game.
logic: NA
